title: Hex map SVG background exceeds dark world threshold
description: The hex map SVG element has background #f4e8c1 (rgb(244, 232, 193)) at 86% brightness. STYLE.md requires world surfaces at 10-40% brightness.
evidence: style={{ background: '#f4e8c1' }} in HexMap.tsx line 119; HSL brightness: 86%
suggestedFix: Change background from '#f4e8c1' to '#2a2a2e' (~18% brightness) or '#1a1a24' (~8% brightness).

title: Modal overlay prevents Wheel button interaction
description: Clicking the Wheel button times out — a modal overlay (aria-hidden=true div) blocks click events, making it impossible to interact with the button normally.
evidence: Expected: Wheel click opens Divine Wheel overlay. Actual: Click times out after 5000ms due to modal overlay intercepting pointer events.
suggestedFix: Ensure modal overlay only blocks when an overlay is actually open. Investigate why aria-hidden modal persists.

title: Wheel overlay activated but does not render visibly
description: After clicking Wheel button (button marked [active]), no visual wheel overlay appears. Wheel state is active in DOM but UI component is missing.
evidence: Expected: Wheel overlay with action slots appears. Actual: Wheel button active but no overlay rendered.
suggestedFix: Check if wheel rendering is conditional on agent selection. No agents under influence may cause conditional non-render — add feedback.

title: Hostility label repeated 3x in Rival Gods section
description: 'Hostility' appears 3 times identically in the Rival Gods section, once per rival. Redundant labeling.
evidence: Hostility appears 3 times at x=25, y=705/766/827
suggestedFix: Remove per-rival 'Hostility' label. Add once as section header if needed.

title: Right sidebar is empty placeholder when no agent selected
description: Right sidebar (350px × 1325px) shows only 'No agents under your influence yet.' — wasted screen real estate.
suggestedFix: When no agent selected, show mandate summary, quick stats, or contextual help. Or expand center map.

title: Missing H2 level — H1 → H3 jump violates semantic hierarchy
description: Heading structure jumps from H1 ('The Warlord Ascendant') to H3 ('Time', 'Divine Essence', 'Rival Gods'). H2 skipped entirely.
evidence: H1 → H3 with no H2 in between
suggestedFix: Change H3s to H2s, or insert an H2 grouping header.

title: Narrative feed contains 27+ duplicated actor+realm combinations
description: 86 items, 353 words. 27 unique strings appear 2+ times (e.g., 'Kira acted in the realm of life.' 4x). Creates log fatigue.
evidence: Kael in spirit 3x, Kira in life 4x, essence flows 4x, rival actions 4x each
suggestedFix: Implement log aggregation: group repeated actions with count badge ('Kael acted in spirit ×3').

title: Avatar name appears twice (sidebar + HUD)
description: 'The Wandering Sage' shown in left sidebar subtitle AND as AvatarHUD button label. Redundant.
evidence: x=16,y=116 'Avatar: The Wandering Sage · Cycle 1' and x=360,y=142 button label
suggestedFix: Remove or abbreviate the AvatarHUD duplicate. Sidebar already shows the full name.

title: Rival action text repeated verbatim across ticks
description: Rival god actions ('The Veiled Prophet extends their reach...') appear 3-4 times with identical wording. No variation.
evidence: 3 rival actions × 4 occurrences each = 12 identical sentences
suggestedFix: Create 3-5 template variants per rival action type for text shuffling.

title: Mandate tracker shows 0% with no context
description: Mandate progress shows '0%' for 26+ ticks with no explanation. Zero-value display with no actionable info.
evidence: 'The Ascendant's Champion | 0%' — zero value for extended duration
suggestedFix: Show progress label ('Active', 'New') or condition tooltip explaining the 0% state.

title: Mandate tracker popover doesn't close with Escape key
description: Pressing Escape doesn't close mandate popover. Must click 'Click to close' text.
evidence: Expected: Escape closes popover. Actual: Escape ignored.
suggestedFix: Add Escape key handler to mandate tracker popover.

title: No feedback when Wheel clicked with no agents under influence
description: Clicking Wheel with no agents: button activates but gives no feedback explaining why nothing happens.
evidence: Expected: Message like 'Recruit agents first'. Actual: Silent activation.
suggestedFix: Show toast or inline message: 'You must recruit agents to use the Divine Wheel.'

title: Mandate tracker button doesn't toggle popover closed
description: Clicking mandate button again while popover is open doesn't close it. Requires explicit 'Click to close' text.
evidence: Expected: Toggle behavior. Actual: Popover stays open on re-click.
suggestedFix: Implement toggle: second click closes popover.

title: Hex zoom navigation not testable — all hexes dark/unexplored
description: Due to fog of war, couldn't test hex click → HexZoomView → LocationView → breadcrumb back flow.
evidence: Map interaction layer untested due to game state.
suggestedFix: Add dev/test mode toggle for hex visibility. Retest in advanced game state.

title: Missing React.memo on presentational components
description: RetinuePanel, RivalPanel, AgentDetailPanel receive props from GameView without memoization — re-render on every parent render.
suggestedFix: export const RetinuePanel = React.memo(function RetinuePanel({...}: Props) { ... })

title: Hardcoded magic numbers violate tunability priority #1
description: WHEEL_RADIUS=80, SLOT_RADIUS=14, HEX_RADIUS=260, LOCATION_RADIUS=40, AGENT_SIZE=28 — defined inline without named constants.
suggestedFix: Group as: const WHEEL_CONFIG = { RADIUS: 80, SLOT_RADIUS: 14 } as const

title: Inline object creation in JSX causes re-renders
description: GameView.tsx creates new sphereColorMap object on every render. AvatarHUD.tsx creates new style objects every render.
suggestedFix: Move to module-level const or useMemo.

title: SVG elements with click handlers lack accessibility attributes
description: AgentWheel and HexZoomView have clickable SVG elements without role='button', aria-label, or keyboard support.
suggestedFix: <circle onClick={...} role='button' aria-label='...' tabIndex={0} onKeyDown={...} />

title: GameView.tsx at 770 lines exceeds recommended 300-line limit
description: Single component with 40+ handlers, 10+ useState calls, 15+ useMemo blocks. Too many concerns mixed.
suggestedFix: Extract: TickController, ViewLevelManager, InterventionFlow, ScryFlow into hook-based sub-components.

title: Inline event handlers disable optimization
description: GameView passes inline arrow function props to AgentWheel, HexZoomView, ScryOverlay. Breaks referential equality.
suggestedFix: Wrap handlers in useCallback.

title: Button text brightness at 89% may have contrast issues on some backgrounds
description: Button text rgb(254, 243, 199) at 89% brightness. Good contrast on dark buttons, but needs verification across all variants.
suggestedFix: Verify WCAG AA contrast ratios across all button variants.

title: Inline color strings scattered across 6+ components
description: SPHERE_COLORS, STRAND_COLORS, TIER_COLORS defined locally in StrandView, HexBreadcrumb, EssencePanel, AgentDetailPanel. Should be centralized.
suggestedFix: Create src/constants/colors.ts with shared color maps.

title: Icon-only buttons missing aria-label
description: StrandView '✕' button, HexBreadcrumb '←' button lack aria-label.
suggestedFix: <button aria-label='Close strand view'>✕</button>

title: Duplicate agentColor function in two files
description: Identical agentColor() in LocationView.tsx:14-19 and HexZoomView.tsx:25-30.
suggestedFix: Extract to src/lib/agentColor.ts.

title: String literals for domain/sphere names instead of shared enums
description: AgentDetailPanel DOMAIN_NAMES, DoomBar ARCHETYPE_COLORS, MandateTracker type strings — all hardcoded locally.
suggestedFix: Import from types/ instead of duplicating.

title: Missing keyboard navigation for interactive SVG elements
description: HexMap and AgentWheel SVG click handlers have no keyboard support (Tab/Enter).
suggestedFix: Add onKeyDown handlers for Enter/Space keys.

title: Missing error boundaries and edge case handling
description: GameView getLineOfSight with null ascendantId, ScryOverlay returns null without user message, HexZoomView no validation.
suggestedFix: Add error boundary wrapper and fallback UI.

title: useMemo deps include gameState.tick causing invalidation every frame
description: retinueAgents, hexLocations memos depend on gameState.tick but content only changes when graph changes.
suggestedFix: Replace tick with [gameState.graph, gameState.ascendantId].

title: Magic number 35 (angle degrees) in HexZoomView
description: HexZoomView line 147 uses unexplained magic number 35 for agent arc angle step.
suggestedFix: const AGENT_ARC_ANGLE_STEP = 35;

title: Pure black body text may not match dark theme aesthetic
description: Body text uses rgb(0,0,0). Atmospheric dark-world narrative might benefit from warm, slightly-light text.
suggestedFix: Consider warm text color ~70% brightness for narrative elements.

title: Emoji icons used for spheres instead of sphere-colored SVG icons
description: ⚡🧠🪨🔥🌿👻⏳🌀 used instead of custom sphere form language icons per STYLE.md.
evidence: Divine Essence panel, Rival Gods list
suggestedFix: Create SVG icon set per sphere form language. Emoji acceptable as temporary placeholders.

title: Right sidebar placeholder text not actionable
description: 'No agents under your influence yet.' provides no guidance on what to do.
suggestedFix: Change to: 'Click an agent in the feed to view details. Or use the Wheel to intervene.'

title: 6 of 8 sphere essence values identical (3.7)
description: Low variance in essence values reduces visual interest in Divine Essence grid.
suggestedFix: Add sparkline/trend indicators. Or adjust simulation balance for more variance.

title: Mandate condition uses ambiguous ○ circle symbol
description: Empty circle (○) is unclear — could mean unchecked or unmet.
suggestedFix: Use ☐/✓ or color-coded icons for met/unmet conditions.

title: UI chrome uses RGB instead of OKLch specification
description: STYLE.md specifies oklch(0.21-0.24) for UI chrome. Implementation uses RGB hex values.
evidence: rgb(120,53,15), rgb(68,64,60) — brightness correct but not OKLch
suggestedFix: Phased migration to OKLch notation for perceptual consistency.

title: Simple derived values don't need useMemo
description: seasonName and year computed from tick — simple math that doesn't benefit from memoization.
suggestedFix: Remove useMemo wrapper for trivial computations.

title: Prop drilling 10+ props suggests Context API needed
description: GameView passes selectedAgentId, wheelSlots, scryState through multiple levels.
suggestedFix: Create GameContext for shared state.

title: Play/Pause buttons lack press animation
description: Button label changes but no visual press feedback or color change.
suggestedFix: Add CSS active state styling for tactile feedback.

title: Wheel button tooltip doesn't explain prerequisites
description: title='Divine Wheel' but no info about needing agents.
suggestedFix: Update title: 'Divine Wheel — Recruit agents to use actions on them.'

title: Inconsistent component export patterns
description: Mix of forwardRef with displayName, export function, and const arrow patterns.
suggestedFix: Standardize to one pattern: export const Comp = React.memo(function Comp(props) { ... })
